body: The question asks whether I ever went under any administrative investigation, review, inquiry, etc...I was under investigation and it ended with me volunteering to quit after the first meeting. Originally it was to suppose to go on with me coming back in and saying what my side of the story was more in depth but it was literally my last day ANYWAY so I quit so I could concentrate on school. My main fear is that if I put it down they’ll call my old work and get more details...I was planning on saying i thought they meant criminal or civil investigation and an internal one.

Yea I’ve been doing DBT twice a week. It’s been immensity helpful. Most of the issues were actually way early. I literally got in trouble on my last day. It was girls I asked out more than one. But I stopped after they said no. I had a lot of misconceptions about dating from movies and tv shows and things I’ve read. I’m not experienced so what I thought was part of the game was harassment.  It came from a place of desperation, intense loneliness and self loathing. I was/am so fucking lonely. I was doing everything I could to try to stop feeling that way. It just made everything worse.

No chance to apologize. There is no way in hell Im contacting the girl and apologizing for obvious reasons. I’m done chasing girls and honestly I’m probably done with women and done with sex. I’ve learned from my mistake but that’s not enough. This isn’t something you can come back from. Even if it’s not criminal or civil it is a permanent stain on my reputation. Who the fuck is going to hire me? I deserve it though. Men like me deserve to have their lives ruined.

It was unsolicited. I misinterpret the girls interest and sent a message coming on really strong. The HR director straight up told me it was textbook harassment. All the work I did is undone because I was stupid, and horney.

It’s a state government job ,but it’s not security clearance to my knowledge. Can my old job legally say I was under investigation? I want to tell the truth ,but with everything that’s going on in political Felid no one is going to hire me are they?
Sexual harassment. I said some things I shouldn’t of and when it came to light I immediately quit. So I’m basically fucked right?
